A.root_cause: Each step reported the expected result (staged, applied 192.168.50.1 on eth1, committed to startup config) and the read-back shows 192.168.50.1/24 on eth1; the log never reads back /etc/nb/lan.committed, but nothing in it contradicts the success claim.

B.root_cause: The site notes name the startup config /etc/nb/lan.committed, but no process ever opens it: net-commit's save (mktemp + cp, then mv) lands in /run/nb/lan.committed.*, the volatile runtime directory, so the address is live now but the startup config keeps the old one and the change is lost at reboot.
